name: kustomer
label: Kustomer
description: Create and manage Kustomer customers, conversations, and custom objects.

token.label: API Token
token.description:
Authenticate using a Kustomer API token.

Paste a private Kustomer API token with access to customers, conversations, and KObjects.

create-customer.label: Create Customer
create-customer.description: Creates a new customer record in Kustomer.

email.label: Email Address
email.description: Primary email address of the customer.

phone.label: Phone Number
phone.description: Primary phone number in E.164 format (e.g. "+14155551234").

company.label: Company
company.description: Name of the company the customer belongs to.

externalId.label: External ID
externalId.description: Unique identifier from your own system (e.g. your CRM or database ID). Used to link this Kustomer record back to your data.

username.label: Username
username.description: The customer's username in your system.

birthdayAt.label: Birthday
birthdayAt.description: Customer's birth date in ISO 8601 format (e.g. "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z").

signedUpAt.label: Signed Up At
signedUpAt.description: When the customer registered, in ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z").

avatarUrl.label: Avatar URL
avatarUrl.description: URL of the customer's profile image.

create-conversation.label: Create Conversation
create-conversation.description: Creates a new conversation in Kustomer.

customer.label: Customer ID
customer.description: The Kustomer ID of the customer this conversation belongs to. You can get this from the "Get Customer" action or from the URL when viewing a customer in Kustomer.

name.label: Conversation Name
name.description: A short subject or title for the conversation (max 256 characters).

status.label: Status
status.description: The initial status of the conversation.

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: "Inbound" means the customer initiated the conversation; "Outbound" means your team initiated it.

externalId.label: External ID
externalId.description: A unique identifier from your own system to link this conversation (max 256 characters).

replyChannel.label: Reply Channel
replyChannel.description: The channel used to reply in this conversation (e.g. "email", "chat"). Leave empty to use the workspace default.

update-conversation.label: Update Conversation
update-conversation.description: Updates an existing conversation in Kustomer.

conversationId.label: Conversation ID
conversationId.description: The Kustomer ID of the conversation to update. You can get this from the "Create Conversation" action output or from the URL when viewing a conversation in Kustomer.

status.label: Status
status.description: Change the status of the conversation.

name.label: Conversation Name
name.description: Update the subject or title of the conversation.

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: "Inbound" means the customer initiated the conversation; "Outbound" means your team initiated it.

replyChannel.label: Reply Channel
replyChannel.description: The channel used to reply in this conversation (e.g. "email", "chat").

get-customer.label: Get Customer
get-customer.description: Gets a customer by ID from Kustomer.

get-custom-objects.label: Get Custom Objects
get-custom-objects.description: Retrieves all custom objects (KObjects) for a given class in Kustomer.

klassName.label: KObject Class Name
klassName.description: The API name of the custom object class to fetch (e.g. "order", "ticket"). You can find this in Kustomer under Settings > Custom Objects — it is the lowercase identifier, not the display label.

fromDate.label: From Date
fromDate.description: Only return objects created or updated on or after this date. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2024-01-15T00:00:00.000Z"). Leave empty to return all objects.
